sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日新闻简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的人物，包括万斯、

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将现场直播部分采访，任何人都可以免费在 nytimes.com 上观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻报道权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily, today.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听今日《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: As Joe Biden takes a growing lead in the Electoral College,
sentences.zh: 随着乔·拜登在选举人团票上的领先优势不断扩大，

sentences.en: President Trump falsely claims that the election is being stolen from him.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统毫无根据地声称这场选举正在被窃取。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman on his dangerous strategy.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼谈他的危险策略。

sentences.en: It's Friday, November 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月6日，星期五。

sentences.en: Maggie, it feels like we just watched something historic and dark and profoundly alarming just happen at the White House.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，感觉我们刚刚在白宫目睹了一场历史性、黑暗且令人深感震惊的事件。

sentences.en: Michael, that's right.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，确实如此。

sentences.en: We just witnessed something scary at the White House.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚在白宫目睹了可怕的一幕。

sentences.en: We just witnessed something that could have profound impacts on how voters feel about the democratic process, about their trust in the sanctity of the electoral process,
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚目睹了一件可能会对选民如何看待民主进程、如何看待对选举程序神圣性的信任产生深远影响的事，

sentences.en: and something that could have profound implications long after Donald Trump is out of office.
sentences.zh: 这件事产生的深远影响甚至会在唐纳德·特朗普卸任很久之后依然存在。

sentences.en: And so I just want to start by acknowledging that this will be a challenging event to talk about and cover journalistically, but we're going to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想先承认，从新闻角度来谈论和报道这个事件将是一个巨大的挑战，但我们会去做的。

sentences.en: It's important.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

sentences.en: And we're not going to play much of this news conference that the president gave because it was defined by lies and misinformation.
sentences.zh: 而且我们不会播放太多总统发表的那场新闻发布会，因为它是充斥着谎言和虚假信息的。

sentences.en: But I do want to talk about what the president was trying to do here.
sentences.zh: 但我确实想谈谈总统当时究竟在试图做什么。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you can walk us through what happened tonight.
sentences.zh: 我想请你为我们梳理一下今晚发生了什么。

sentences.en: So, Michael, the president announced abruptly that he would be giving a statement from the White House briefing room after being out of view all day.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克尔，总统整天未露面后，突然宣布他将从白宫简报室发表一份声明。

sentences.en: He was working in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 他当时在椭圆形办公室工作。

sentences.en: He took to the podium in the briefing room about an hour after they announced it.
sentences.zh: 在宣布大约一小时后，他走上了简报室的演讲台。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And he looked downcaSt. He looked dejected.
sentences.zh: 他看起来垂头丧气。他显得很沮丧。

sentences.en: He had something in his hand.
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着东西。

sentences.en: There were some notes that he later read from.
sentences.zh: 有一些他后来据此宣读的笔记。

sentences.en: And to the extent that aides knew what he was going to say, they said that he was going to talk about polls and polling site issues in various states.
sentences.zh: 就助手们对他的发言内容的了解而言，他们说他原本打算讨论各州的民调以及投票站的问题。

sentences.en: But most of them didn't really know what he was going to say.
sentences.zh: 但他们大多数人并不知道他到底要说些什么。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好。

sentences.en: I'd like to provide the American people with an update on our efforts to protect the integrity of our very important 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 我想向美国人民通报我们为保护我们至关重要的2020年大选的公正性所做努力的最新进展。

sentences.en: If you count the legal votes, I easily win.
sentences.zh: 如果计算合法选票，我轻易就能获胜。

sentences.en: And when he spoke, he began by declaring that if you count the quote-unquote legal votes, that he had won the election easily.
sentences.zh: 当他发言时，他首先宣称，如果计算所谓的合法选票，他已经轻松赢得了大选。

sentences.en: This is obviously a lie.
sentences.zh: 这显然是个谎言。

sentences.en: The votes that have been counted in various states are legal.
sentences.zh: 各州统计的选票都是合法的。

sentences.en: We've just never heard something like this from a U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没有听过美国总统发表这样的话，

sentences.en: president, at least not in the last century and possibly not ever.
sentences.zh: 至少在过去的一个世纪里没有，甚至可能从来没有过。

sentences.en: We won these and many other victories.
sentences.zh: 我们赢得了这些以及许多其他的胜利。

sentences.en: Despite historic election interference from big media, big money, and big tech.
sentences.zh: 尽管面临来自大媒体、大金主和大科技公司历史性的选举干预。

sentences.en: And then he turned to what he painted as essentially a broad conspiracy against him by Democrats, by polling site workers, and by the media.
sentences.zh: 接着，他将矛头指向了他所描绘的民主党人、投票站工作人员和媒体针对他的一场广泛阴谋。

sentences.en: He talked about media polling before the election.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了选举前的媒体民调。

sentences.en: And he has talked about some of this before.
sentences.zh: 他以前也谈到过其中一些内容。

sentences.en: But he was painting it as part of a grander effort to suppress his voters, to try to keep people from turning out because they felt that he would be losing so badly,
sentences.zh: 但他将其描述为一项更宏大计划的一部分，旨在压制他的选民，试图阻止人们出来投票，因为他们觉得他会输得很惨，

sentences.en: and that newspapers were all in on it.
sentences.zh: 并且报纸也都同流合污。

sentences.en: Maggie, I want to pause to talk about that part of this news conference.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，我想停下来谈谈这场新闻发布会的那个部分。

sentences.en: The polls were off again this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的民调再次失准了。

sentences.en: They did, in a few cases, like Wisconsin, overestimate how well Joe Biden would do in the battleground states.
sentences.zh: 在少数情况下，比如威斯康星州，它们确实高估了乔·拜登在摇摆州的表现。

sentences.en: But the story the president is telling here is that they were intentionally off, and that news organizations doing polling got it wrong on purpose,
sentences.zh: 但总统在这里讲述的故事是，民调是故意失准的，从事民调的新闻机构是故意搞错的，

sentences.en: the notion being, from what he said, that that would somehow suppress Republican voters, either by discouraging them or discouraging fundraising.
sentences.zh: 根据他的说法，其用意在于通过打击选民士气或筹款士气，从而变相压制共和党选民。

sentences.en: Is that what he's saying?
sentences.zh: 他是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: Michael, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，完全正确。

sentences.en: And you are correct that some of the polling was off this year in several places.
sentences.zh: 你说得对，今年有些地方的民调确实失准了。

sentences.en: But he painted it as part of a broader scheme to keep his voters from wanting to go out on election day and vote.
sentences.zh: 但他将其描绘成一个更广泛阴谋的一部分，旨在阻止他的选民在选举日出门投票。

sentences.en: Right, which is not true.
sentences.zh: 对，而这不是真的。

sentences.en: This is, I would hope it was self-evident, but this is not true.
sentences.zh: 这，我希望这是不言而喻的，但这不是真的。

sentences.en: But it is decidedly not true.
sentences.zh: 而且这绝对不是真的。

sentences.en: And what do you think the intention of that focus is from the president?
sentences.zh: 你认为总统聚焦于这一点的意图是什么？

sentences.en: So the president, Michael, has long painted outcomes that he doesn't like as part of a grander conspiracy or effort to undermine him.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，长期以来，总统一直把不合他心意的结果描绘成蓄意破坏他的更大阴谋或行动的一部分。

sentences.en: And what he was trying to do here is suggest that there was a broad attempt to take this election from him.
sentences.zh: 他在这里试图表达的是，存在着一场从他手中夺走这场选举的广泛图谋。

sentences.en: And that everything that he doesn't like was part of that.
sentences.zh: 而且所有他不喜欢的事件都是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: And as we have seen him do many times in the past, he reaches for sort of random, disparate pieces of evidence that he can point to, to say that these support his statement.
sentences.zh: 正如我们过去多次看到的那样，他会找一些随机、零散的证据来支撑他的说法。

sentences.en: In the case of the media, it was the polling.
sentences.zh: 就媒体而言，证据是民调。

sentences.en: In the case of individual states, he pointed to random incidents involving specific ballots or election workers.
sentences.zh: 就各个州而言，他则指向涉及特定选票或选举工作人员的随机事件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Let's talk about what the president is claiming about the process and the personnel involved in counting the actual vote from election day.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈总统对选举日实际选票统计过程及相关人员的指控。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So in terms of the process, Michael, he pointed to a bunch of different incidents in a couple of states.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，就过程而言，他指出了几个州发生的一系列不同事件。

sentences.en: And he described the lead that he had had.
sentences.zh: 他描述了他原本拥有的领先优势。

sentences.en: We were winning in all the key locations by a lot, actually.
sentences.zh: 我们在所有关键地点都获胜了，而且幅度很大，事实上。

sentences.en: And then our numbers started miraculously getting whittled away in secret.
sentences.zh: 然后我们的数字开始在暗中神不知鬼不觉地被削减。

sentences.en: As getting, quote unquote, whittled down.
sentences.zh: 也就是所谓的被“蚕食”。

sentences.en: So for instance, he pointed to Georgia and he said that...
sentences.zh: 比如，他提到了佐治亚州，他说……

sentences.en: Likewise in Georgia, I won by a lot.
sentences.zh: 同样在佐治亚州，我赢了很多。

sentences.en: A lot.
sentences.zh: 赢了很多。

sentences.en: His lead had been close to 300,000 votes on election night in that state, but it, quote unquote, got whittled down.
sentences.zh: 选举之夜，他在该州的领先优势曾接近30万票，但它被所谓的“蚕食”了。

sentences.en: And now it's getting to be to a point where I'll go from winning by a lot to perhaps being even down a little bit.
sentences.zh: 而现在，情况正变得让我从遥遥领先，甚至可能变成稍稍落后。

sentences.en: He pointed to something similar in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 他在密歇根州也指出了类似的情况。

sentences.en: And that got whittled down.
sentences.zh: 而那也被蚕食了。

sentences.en: In every case, they got whittled down.
sentences.zh: 在每一种情况下，它们都被蚕食了。

sentences.en: And the idea here that he was positing, which again is baseless, is that he had these leads and then people who oppose him and election workers
sentences.zh: 他提出的这种观点同样毫无根据，即他原本享有领先优势，随后反对他的人和选举工作人员

sentences.en: forged some deal to try to manufacture enough ballots to overtake his lead.
sentences.zh: 达成某种协议，试图伪造足够的选票来超过他的领先优势。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Maggie, what is actually happening in these states that the president is trying to characterize as some form of corruption?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，总统试图将其定性为某种腐败形式的这些州，实际上正在发生什么？

sentences.en: What's happening, Michael, is vote counting.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，正在发生的事情是点票。

sentences.en: Only since this man became president has there been a president announcing that the election results should be called on election night.
sentences.zh: 只有自这个人当上总统以来，才有过总统宣称选举结果应该在选举之夜见分晓的情况。

sentences.en: Sometimes it is, but sometimes it's not clear because these are close elections.
sentences.zh: 有时确实如此，但有时并不明朗，因为这些是势均力敌的选举。

sentences.en: And it's been very clear that this was always going to be a close race in certain states.
sentences.zh: 而且很显然，在某些州，这注定是一场势均力敌的竞选。

sentences.en: And this is an election with a very high number of absentee ballots and early votes.
sentences.zh: 这是一场拥有极高数量缺席选票和提前投票的选举。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because of the pandemic, a number of states adjusted their processes.
sentences.zh: 由于疫情，许多州调整了他们的流程。

sentences.en: And we've never had this number of states having such a huge quantity of early votes and absentee ballots.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没有遇到过这么多州拥有如此庞大数量的提前投票和缺席选票。

sentences.en: So they are counting votes.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在统计选票。

sentences.en: They are doing what is legal, and he is painting it as a conspiracy against him.
sentences.zh: 他们在做合法的事情，而他却将其描绘成针对他的阴谋。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Maggie, correct me if I'm wrong, I believe the president himself is partially responsible for the reason the count is working the way it is.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，如果我没说错的话，请纠正我，我认为总统本人对计票方式之所以变成现在这样负有部分责任。

sentences.en: He was involved in filing lawsuits, asking that mail-in ballots not be counted before election day.
sentences.zh: 他曾参与提起诉讼，要求不要在选举日前统计邮寄选票。

sentences.en: In some cases, he absolutely was, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，在某些情况下，他绝对这么做了。

sentences.en: And I would argue there's another way that he is responsible for this, which is that he has been casting aspersions on the by-mail voting system writ large for months.
sentences.zh: 我认为他在另一个层面上也负有责任，那就是他数月来一直在对整个邮寄投票系统进行抹黑。

sentences.en: Republican leaders asked him, his own campaign advisors asked him to please stop doing that because he was depressing his own vote,
sentences.zh: 共和党领袖曾要求他，他自己的竞选顾问也曾要求他请停止这样做，因为他正在打击自身的选票，

sentences.en: including among seniors who vote heavily by absentee ballot by doing this.
sentences.zh: 其中包括那些大量通过缺席投票的老年选民。

sentences.en: And by making people mistrustful of a system, he was potentially impacting his own voters.
sentences.zh: 通过让人对制度产生不信任，他可能正在对自己的选民产生负面影响。

sentences.en: There's every reason to believe that that could have happened too.
sentences.zh: 完全有理由相信这种情况也可能发生过。

sentences.en: So, yes, the president has created a situation, at least partly by his own hand, where more Democrats were voting by absentee and by early vote.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，总统至少有一部分是自己制造了这样一种局面：更多的民主党人通过缺席投票和提前投票来投票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And basically, he's describing a phenomenon we had always anticipated, which is this kind of surge of Republican votes on election day for Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 基本上，他正在描述一种我们一直预料到的现象，即特朗普在选举日获得的那种共和党选票激增，对吧？

sentences.en: This red mirage yielding to mail-in ballots a day later or two days later breaking for Biden.
sentences.zh: 这种红色海市蜃楼让位于一天或两天后有利于拜登的邮寄选票。

sentences.en: And he is describing that counting process and the inevitable fluctuation of the vote count
sentences.zh: 而他却将这种计票过程以及选票统计不可避免的波动

sentences.en: as fraudulent or illegal, when in fact, as you just said, it is very much just the process in place right now in this country during a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 描述为欺诈或非法，而事实上，正如你刚才所说，这正是这个国家在疫情期间现行的正常程序。

sentences.en: And one he played a role in.
sentences.zh: 这也是他曾在其中推波助澜的程序。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It's very much this process, and it's been very clear that that was always going to be the process.
sentences.zh: 这正是这一程序，而且很显然，这一直都将是既定的程序。

sentences.en: Maggie, the president also focused on observers,
sentences.zh: 玛吉，总统还将焦点对准了观察员，

sentences.en: the people who watch vote counting.
sentences.zh: 也就是监督计票工作的人。

sentences.en: In this case, at this point, many of them watching mail-in ballots get counted.
sentences.zh: 在这个案子里，此时此刻，他们中的许多人正在监督邮寄选票的统计。

sentences.en: And he seems to be suggesting basically that something sinister is going on there.
sentences.zh: 他似乎基本上在暗示那里正在发生某种不轨行为。

sentences.en: Can you help me understand what he is saying?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我理解他在说什么吗？

sentences.en: What he's trying to say, Michael, is that poll watchers, which is legal to have poll watchers, for his team have been kept illegally from watching.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，他试图表达的是，他的团队有权合法拥有计票观察员，但这些观察员却被非法阻止进行监督。

sentences.en: As we understand it, that is not what has happened in our understanding of incidents where there have been debates.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，在我们所知发生争执的事件中，实际情况并非如此。

sentences.en: There have been efforts to keep poll watchers at bay, or at least at a certain distance.
sentences.zh: 确实有人试图让观察员保持一定距离，或者至少保持在某种特定距离之外。

sentences.en: But again, he is making it all sound as if it is part of some effort to entirely discount everything he's doing.
sentences.zh: 但同样，他把这一切说得好像都是为了彻底否定他所做的一切所做努力的一部分。

sentences.en: So how does this press conference ultimately end?
sentences.zh: 那么这场记者会最终是如何结束的呢？

sentences.en: So the press conference winds down with the president
sentences.zh: 记者会在总统将焦点

sentences.en: focusing on Joe Biden Democrats and saying that he wants them to say they only want, quote unquote, legal votes to be counted.
sentences.zh: 集中在乔·拜登和民主党人身上并称他希望他们表态只希望统计所谓的“合法选票”中逐渐接近尾声。

sentences.en: Because they talk about votes, and I think they should use the word legal, legal votes.
sentences.zh: 因为他们在谈论选票，我认为他们应该使用“合法”这个词，即合法选票。

sentences.en: We want every legal vote counted, and I want every legal vote counted.
sentences.zh: 我们希望每一张合法选票都被统计，我也希望每一张合法选票都被统计。

sentences.en: Democrats would say that that is what they believe, and they've never said otherwise.
sentences.zh: 民主党人会说这正是他们的信念，他们从未说过其他的话。

sentences.en: And we can't let that happen to the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我们不能让这种事发生在美利坚合众国身上。

sentences.en: It's not a question of who wins, Republican, Democrat, Joe, myself.
sentences.zh: 这不是谁赢谁输的问题，无论是共和党、民主党、乔，还是我本人。

sentences.en: We can't let that happen to our country.
sentences.zh: 我们不能让这种事发生在我们的国家。

sentences.en: And then he's trying to sound something of a more sanguine note for a second, where it's sort of, it's not a question of who wins, whether it's Republican, Democrat, Joe, myself.
sentences.zh: 然后他试图表现出一种稍微乐观的调子，也就是这并非关乎谁赢谁输，无论是共和党、民主党、乔，还是我本人。

sentences.en: What he was doing, Michael, was doing something of a dismount from this sort of just shocking several minutes he had spent at the podium,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，他当时在做的是从他在讲台上度过的这令人震惊的几分钟里进行某种缓冲，

sentences.en: combining what clearly people had said to him to say, which was, it's not about who won.
sentences.zh: 将别人显然对他说过的话——即这无关谁赢谁输——结合起来。

sentences.en: And then he goes in and adds his own version, which is, this is all being stolen, and it's a disgrace on our country.
sentences.zh: 然后他又加入了他自己的版本，那就是这一切都在被窃取，这是我们国家的耻辱。

sentences.en: And so that's what was happening there.
sentences.zh: 所以当时发生的就是这样。

sentences.en: As you know, I've claimed certain states, and he's claiming states.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我已经宣布赢得了某些州，他正在宣称拿下某些州。

sentences.en: And he ends by saying that he's claimed certain states, and then Biden has claimed certain states, which we just want to be very clear here is not how this works.
sentences.zh: 他最后说他已经宣布赢得了某些州，然后拜登也宣布赢得了某些州，我们在这里只想明确一点，这不是运作方式。

sentences.en: But ultimately, I have a feeling judges are going to have to rule.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我有一种感觉，法官们将不得不做出裁决。

sentences.en: And that he has a feeling that, quote-unquote, judges are going to have to be involved in this.
sentences.zh: 并且他有一种感觉，所谓的“法官”将不得不介入其中。

sentences.en: And the person who has been filing a lot of lawsuits so far is Trump in his campaign.
sentences.zh: 而迄今为止提起大量诉讼的人正是特朗普和他的竞选团队。

sentences.en: Right, he sort of commits himself to a path of litigation.
sentences.zh: 没错，他某种程度上让自己走上了诉讼这条路。

sentences.en: To the extent, Michael, that Donald Trump commits himself to anything, yes, he certainly forecasts that they're going to go down the legal route for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，就唐纳德·特朗普承诺会坚持某件事而言，是的，他当然预测他们在可预见的未来将走法律途径。

sentences.en: But there's been a lot of shenanigans, and we can't stand for that in our country.
sentences.zh: 但是这里有很多猫腻，我们不能在我们的国家容忍这种事。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Maggie, in spite of the fact that the president is saying he could still win this election, it felt to some degree that in his own peculiar way, you would know much better than me,
sentences.zh: 玛吉，尽管总统一直在说他仍然可能赢得这次选举，但在某种程度上，用他那种奇特的方式——你肯定比我更清楚——

sentences.en: that in this news conference he was acknowledging that he's losing this race, right?
sentences.zh: 他在这次新闻发布会上承认自己输了这场竞选，对吧？

sentences.en: He's not denying the math, he's denying its legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 他不是在否定票数统计，而是在否定其合法性。

sentences.en: That's exactly right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Look, this was, to the extent that we see politicians, and you and I have covered politicians who have won and who have lost,
sentences.zh: 听着，就我们所看到的政客而言——你我都采访过赢过也输过的政客——

sentences.en: and every politician who loses goes through something of a stage of grief.
sentences.zh: 每一个落选的政客都会经历某种程度的悲伤阶段。

sentences.en: This is a president who had never so much as run for city council when he ran for and won the presidency.
sentences.zh: 这位总统在参加并赢得总统大选之前，甚至从未竞选过市议员。

sentences.en: And losing is a wholly unfamiliar experience for him in life in general, but certainly something that just can't be spun, which is what he's trying to do.
sentences.zh: 对他的整个人生来说，失败是一个完全陌生的经历，但这显然是无法粉饰的，而这正是他现在试图做的。

sentences.en: I should note that the area that the campaign is looking toward in terms of how it could win, the path toward winning, the president and his advisors hold out some hope
sentences.zh: 我需要指出的是，竞选团队在考虑如何才能获胜、通往胜利的道路时，总统和他的顾问们依然抱有一线希望

sentences.en: that he could possibly win both Arizona and Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 认为他有可能同时赢得亚利桑那州和宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: Without those two, there is no path for him retaining the presidency.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这两个州，他就没有办法保住总统职位。

sentences.en: But I think he knows that this is turning against him at the moment, and I think he is struggling to come to terms with that.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他知道局势目前正在对我不利，而且我认为他在努力接受这个现实。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你的第一个月使用期是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》App，获得30天的免费访问权。

sentences.en: Maggie, let's go back to understand everything that led up to this press conference on Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，让我们回顾一下，去了解导致周四晚这场新闻发布会发生的所有前因后果。

sentences.en: The last time we talked to you was on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 我们上一次跟你对话是在选举日当天。

sentences.en: So take us back to election night and help us understand what has gone on in the Trump camp since then.
sentences.zh: 所以请带我们回到选举之夜，帮我们了解自那以后特朗普阵营发生了什么。

sentences.en: On election night, President Trump was in the White House.
sentences.zh: 在选举之夜，特朗普总统在白宫里。

sentences.en: He was in the residence.
sentences.zh: 他在起居室内。

sentences.en: He was watching returns with family members and only a very small number of advisors came in and out.
sentences.zh: 他和家人们一起观看开票结果，只有极少数顾问进进出出。

sentences.en: And initially, they were very excited.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And they were very excited because the first major state, the first battleground to get called was Florida.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以非常兴奋，是因为第一个被宣布结果的大州、第一个摇摆州是佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it was called for the president.
sentences.zh: 而且这个州被判给总统了。

sentences.en: And a lot of the public polling leading into election night had suggested that Florida was not just likely to go for Biden, but would heavily go for Biden.
sentences.zh: 选举之夜前的许多公开民调都表明，佛罗里达州不仅可能投给拜登，而且很大程度上会投给拜登。

sentences.en: And so for Trump, who's very superstitious, winning Florida became reminiscent of his 2016 win.
sentences.zh: 因此，对极其迷信的特朗普来说，赢得佛罗里达州让他想起了2016年的胜选。

sentences.en: When on election night that year, Florida going his way was vital.
sentences.zh: 当年选举之夜，佛罗里达州倒向他至关重要。

sentences.en: And so his folks and he felt like this was going to be something of a recasting of that night.
sentences.zh: 所以他和他的团队觉得这将会是那一晚情景的重演。

sentences.en: And they were feeling great.
sentences.zh: 他们当时感觉棒极了。

sentences.en: And then suddenly.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间。

sentences.en: OK, time out.
sentences.zh: 好了，暂停。

sentences.en: This is a big development.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大进展。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Fox News decision desk is calling Arizona for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻决定台将亚利桑那州判给乔·拜登。

sentences.en: That is a big get for the Biden campaign.
sentences.zh: 这对拜登竞选团队来说是个巨大的斩获。

sentences.en: Fox News called Arizona for Biden.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻将亚利桑那州判给了拜登。

sentences.en: Are you 100 percent sure of that call and when you made it and why did you make it?
sentences.zh: 你们对这个结果有百分之百的把握吗？你们是什么时候做出决定的？为什么做出这个决定？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有把握。

sentences.en: We made it after basically a half hour of debating.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上经过了半小时的辩论才做出这个决定。

sentences.en: Is it time yet?
sentences.zh: 现在是时候了吗？

sentences.en: Because it's been clear for a while.
sentences.zh: 因为局势有一段时间已经很明朗了。

sentences.en: And their excitement and their good mood was completely punctured.
sentences.zh: 他们的兴奋和好心情瞬间被打消了。

sentences.en: The president, some of his top advisors were absolutely livid.
sentences.zh: 总统和他的几位顶级顾问气急败坏。

sentences.en: They started frantically reaching out to Fox to try to get the call taken back.
sentences.zh: 他们开始疯狂联系福克斯，试图收回这个预测结果。

sentences.en: Jared Kushner, the president's senior advisor and son-in-law, called Rupert Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 总统的高级顾问兼女婿贾里德·库什纳给鲁珀特·默多克打了电话。

sentences.en: None of this was to any avail.
sentences.zh: 这一切都徒劳无功。

sentences.en: And a few hours later, the Associated Press called Arizona for Biden as well.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，美联社也把亚利桑那州判给了拜登。

sentences.en: Some of the president's advisors wanted him to go out and talk at some point before midnight so that he could be the first person to speak.
sentences.zh: 总统的一些顾问希望他在午夜前的某个时候出去发表讲话，这样他就能成为第一个发言的人。

sentences.en: But that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但这件事没有发生。

sentences.en: And instead, Joe Biden went out and gave a statement in Delaware, a very brief statement,
sentences.zh: 相反，乔·拜登在特拉华州发表了一份声明，一份非常简短的声明

sentences.en: but a very traditional, when an election is not called yet, statement of, you know, we're going to win this.
sentences.zh: 但这是一份非常传统的声明——在选举结果尚未揭晓时，传达“你知道的，我们要赢了”这种信息的声明。

sentences.en: And the president was livid again.
sentences.zh: 总统再次勃然大怒。

sentences.en: He tweeted, which is often a sign that he's not happy.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上发文，这通常是他不高兴的信号。

sentences.en: And he tweeted he was going to give a statement of his own.
sentences.zh: 他发推说他将发表自己的声明。

sentences.en: And around 2 a.m., maybe a little bit after, give a statement he did.
sentences.zh: 在凌晨2点左右，或者稍微晚一点，他确实发表了声明。

sentences.en: He descended from the upper floors of the White House residence.
sentences.zh: 他从白宫住宅区的楼上走下来。

sentences.en: He was on the east side of the White House.
sentences.zh: 他来到了白宫的东侧。

sentences.en: He spoke at a podium on a platform that had been built for the night.
sentences.zh: 他在为当晚搭建的平台上的讲台前发表了讲话。

sentences.en: And he was angry.
sentences.zh: 他很愤怒。

sentences.en: He said that this was a fraud on the American people.
sentences.zh: 他说这对美国人民是一场欺诈。

sentences.en: He said that he had won the election.
sentences.zh: 他说他赢得了这场大选。

sentences.en: And that set the tone for what has happened over the last few days.
sentences.zh: 这为过去几天发生的事情定下了基调。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's soon after that, the next morning and afternoon, that the lawsuits begin.
sentences.zh: 就在那之后不久，第二天早晨和下午，诉讼就开始了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, some of the lawsuits were already in place.
sentences.zh: 现在，一些诉讼已经提起了。

sentences.en: There was a lawsuit in Pennsylvania that the campaign joined.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州有一场诉讼是竞选团队加入的。

sentences.en: But in several states, they suddenly started filing lawsuits over the last few days.
sentences.zh: 但在几个州，他们在过去几天里突然开始提起诉讼。

sentences.en: Georgia was one of the places they announced a lawsuit that they were planning to file in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州就是他们宣布计划在内华达州提起诉讼的地方之一。

sentences.en: A bunch of key battlegrounds that had either been leaning toward Joe Biden or were likely to get called for Joe Biden that they wanted to try to impact the counting in.
sentences.zh: 一堆关键摇摆州，要么原本倾向于乔·拜登，要么即将被判给乔·拜登，他们想试图对这些州的计票工作产生影响。

sentences.en: And what were the nature of these lawsuits?
sentences.zh: 这些诉讼的性质是什么？

sentences.en: It depends by state, but in some cases, it's about counting irregularities.
sentences.zh: 因州而异，但在某些情况下，是关于计票违规行为的。

sentences.en: In the case of Pennsylvania, it was joining an existing suit related to an extended period of time for when ballots that had come in during a certain period could be counted,
sentences.zh: 就宾夕法尼亚州而言，它是加入了一起现有的诉讼，该诉讼涉及在特定时期内收到的选票可以被计算的延长时限

sentences.en: whether they were after the actual election day for a few days.
sentences.zh: 即它们是否在实际选举日之后几天内收到。

sentences.en: And some of them are seen by legal experts as fairly frivolous.
sentences.zh: 其中一些诉讼被法律专家视为相当轻率无聊。

sentences.en: I imagine you've been on the phone with White House officials, campaign officials, all day long in the past 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 我猜你在过去48小时里整天都在和白宫官员、竞选团队官员通电话。

sentences.en: What else have you been hearing about what's been going on inside this operation since election night?
sentences.zh: 自选举之夜以来，关于这个运作机器内部发生的事情，你还听到了什么？

sentences.en: Look, there's a sense of shock for some people.
sentences.zh: 听着，对某些人来说有一种震惊感。

sentences.en: You'd really be surprised at how many people, particularly in the White House and also on the campaign, believe that Donald Trump winning was a certainty.
sentences.zh: 你真的会惊讶于有多少人，特别是在白宫和竞选团队中，认为唐纳德·特朗普的胜利是板上钉钉的。

sentences.en: And so there are many of them in a state of shock.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当中有许多人处于震惊状态。

sentences.en: And I think that brings us back to tonight and to the president's speech.
sentences.zh: 我想这把我们带回了今晚以及总统的演讲。

sentences.en: And Maggie, as I was watching, I couldn't help but think that in many ways,
sentences.zh: 玛吉，当我观看的时候，我不禁想到，在很多方面

sentences.en: Trump has spent the last four years laying the groundwork for what he was doing during this news conference by attacking the media, attacking the electoral process,
sentences.zh: 特朗普在过去四年里一直在为他在这次新闻发布会上的所作所为奠定基础，通过攻击媒体、攻击选举过程——

sentences.en: something he started doing the moment he was elected.
sentences.zh: 这是他一当选就开始做的事情。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Attacking any system he sees as disadvantaging him and portraying those systems as run by his enemies.
sentences.zh: 攻击任何他认为对自己不利的系统，并将这些系统描绘成由他的敌人掌控。

sentences.en: In some ways, it feels like what happened on Thursday night was inevitable.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，感觉周四晚上发生的事情是不可避免的。

sentences.en: I think that's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我认为是这样的，迈克尔。

sentences.en: But I think something can be inevitable and still nonetheless be shocking.
sentences.zh: 但我认为有些事可以是不可避免的，但同时依然令人震惊。

sentences.en: We're talking about a president who called the election he won rigged in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是一位在2016年称自己赢得的选举遭到操纵的总统。

sentences.en: Right, because he felt he should have won the popular vote, even though he didn't.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为他觉得自己本该赢得普选票，尽管他没有赢。

sentences.en: He claimed that he had really won the popular vote.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己实际上赢得了普选票。

sentences.en: He made outrageous allegations about millions of illegal votes being cast for Hillary Clinton, and that's why she won the popular vote.
sentences.zh: 他提出了骇人听闻的指控，称数百万非法选票投给了希拉里·克林顿，这就是她赢得普选票的原因。

sentences.en: He has made allegations about voter fraud ever since then, only escalating the scale with which he has made those allegations.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，他一直提出关于选民欺诈的指控，而且他提出这些指控的规模不断升级。

sentences.en: And he has questioned anything that has been in any way in his mind, in his way, or critical of him, or against him.
sentences.zh: 任何在他看来阻碍他、批评他或反对他的事情，他都会质疑。

sentences.en: And so, sure, all of that came cacophonously together for him to say something that, again, was not surprising, but was shocking.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，所有这一切在他身上交织爆发，让他说出了那些——再次说明——并不令人意外、但依然令人震惊的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm interested that you're using that word.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很感兴趣你用了这个词。

sentences.en: I don't consider you easily shocked.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你不是那么容易被震惊的人。

sentences.en: I am not easily shocked.
sentences.zh: 我确实不容易被震惊。

sentences.en: And as you know, I have been surprised at how often people have been shocked over the four years by some of what he does,
sentences.zh: 如你所知，过去四年里，对于人们经常对他的某些做法感到震惊，我一直感到惊讶，

sentences.en: because it's been clear that he's, if you were paying attention to his campaign in 2016, that this is what he's going to do.
sentences.zh: 因为很明显，如果你关注过他2016年的竞选，这就是他要做的事。

sentences.en: Many of these things.
sentences.zh: 其中许多事情都是如此。

sentences.en: But seeing an American president calling a still-in-progress election amid a pandemic a fraud on the public was shocking.
sentences.zh: 但是看到一位美国总统在大流行期间，将一场仍在进行中的选举称作对公众的欺诈，这依然是令人震惊的。

sentences.en: It was just something fundamentally different.
sentences.zh: 这完全是截然不同的性质。

sentences.en: In this moment, Maggie, it feels to me like the ultimate question is, can our system sustain this kind of lie told by the president from the White House?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，此刻在我看来，最根本的问题是：我们的系统能否承受总统从白宫散布的这种谎言？

sentences.en: And it feels like the answer is going to be dependent on the degree to which the president's message is either embraced or rejected by the president's allies within the system.
sentences.zh: 而且答案似乎将取决于系统内部总统的盟友们对总统信息的拥护或拒绝程度。

sentences.en: And here I'm thinking about conservative media, Republicans in Congress, and the rest of the administration, the Department of Justice, for example.
sentences.zh: 这里我想到的是保守派媒体、国会中的共和党人，以及政府的其他部门，例如司法部。

sentences.en: And then, of course, the federal judges appointed by the president.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然还有总统任命的联邦法官。

sentences.en: So what do we know so far?
sentences.zh: 那么我们目前了解到了什么？

sentences.en: It's an excellent question, Michael.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极好的问题，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And so far, there are varying answers.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，答案各有不同。

sentences.en: Fox News reporters and anchors, some of them have pushed back aggressively on what the president has said.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻的记者和主播，他们中的一些人对总统的言论进行了强有力的回击。

sentences.en: People like Brett Baier.
sentences.zh: 像布雷特·拜尔这样的人。

sentences.en: But then you have Sean Hannity, who embraces a lot of what the president said.
sentences.zh: 但接着你有肖恩·汉尼提，他全盘接受了总统所说的大部分内容。

sentences.en: You have Republican leaders like Mitch McConnell, the Senate Majority Leader, silent as the president is saying this.
sentences.zh: 你还有像参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔这样的共和党领袖，在总统发表这些言论时保持沉默。

sentences.en: Most Republican members of Congress, particularly leadership among Republicans in Congress, have been conspicuously silent so far.
sentences.zh: 大多数国会共和党成员，尤其是国会共和党高层，迄今为止都显着地保持着沉默。

sentences.en: You have most members of the Republican leadership class privately expressing concern about some of the president's words,
sentences.zh: 共和党领导层阶层的绝大多数成员私下里对总统的一些言论表示担忧，

sentences.en: but afraid of contradicting him publicly for a variety of reasons, one of which is that nobody wants to exacerbate an already volatile situation.
sentences.zh: 但出于各种原因不敢公开反驳他，其中一个原因就是没有人想让已经动荡的局势雪上加霜。

sentences.en: — Maggie, while we've been talking, so I can't hold you accountable for knowing this,
sentences.zh: ——玛吉，在我们交谈的同时——所以我不能要求你提前知道这一点——

sentences.en: Senators Lindsey Graham and Senator Ted Cruz both appeared on Fox on Sean Hannity and said that they stand with the president.
sentences.zh: 参议员林赛·格雷厄姆和参议员特德·克鲁兹都上了肖恩·汉尼提在福克斯的节目，并表示他们支持总统。

sentences.en: So that's both conservative media and some pretty heavy-hitting Republicans in Congress saying that they support the president and his message in this moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，既有保守派媒体，又有国会中相当重量级的共和党人表示，他们在这个时刻支持总统及其信息。

sentences.en: — Those are two heavy-hitters, but at least Lindsey Graham is doing it under some duress.
sentences.zh: ——那是两个重量级人物，但至少林赛·格雷厄姆是在某种压力下这么做的。

sentences.en: The president's oldest son, Donald Trump Jr., tweeted attacking Lindsey Graham for not speaking out before.
sentences.zh: 总统的长子唐纳德·特朗普小在推特上发文攻击林赛·格雷厄姆之前没有大声说出来。

sentences.en: Ted Cruz also knows that a lot of his own voters are Trump voters, and I imagine that's part of why he's doing it too.
sentences.zh: 特德·克鲁兹也知道他的很多选民都是特朗普的选民，我想这也是他这么做的一部分原因。

sentences.en: — So we shall see if other people embrace this call.
sentences.zh: ——所以我们拭目以待其他人是否会响应这一号召。

sentences.en: — And what about federal judges, especially those appointed by the president?
sentences.zh: ——那么联邦法官呢，尤其是那些由总统任命的法官？

sentences.en: — It's too soon to say, Michael, because these cases, many of them are just beginning to make their way through the system.
sentences.zh: ——现在下结论还为时过早，迈克尔，因为这些案件，其中许多才刚刚开始在系统中走流程。

sentences.en: There is a goal of some of the president's allies to get these lawsuits to wind up in the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 总统的一些盟友的目标是让这些诉讼最终上诉到最高法院。

sentences.en: — Maggie, does it matter whether or not the systems we're talking about support the president in his approach to this strategy of claiming fraud and deception?
sentences.zh: ——玛吉，我们讨论的这些系统是否支持总统声称存在欺诈和骗局的策略，这重要吗？

sentences.en: — Well, Michael, it certainly matters if the courts don't support him.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，迈克尔，如果法院不支持他，那当然很重要。

sentences.en: I mean, they're going to be, in some cases, something of a—if not a last word, then at least a backstop.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某些情况下，它们将起到一种——即使不是最终裁决，至少也是一道防线的作用。

sentences.en: — It matters in terms of the president's ability to run out the string, whether the leadership in the Senate and the House support him on this.
sentences.zh: ——参议院和众议院的领导层是否在这件事上支持他，这关系到总统能否把这出戏演到最后。

sentences.en: And to be clear, there is no chance that Mitch McConnell is happy about what the president has been saying.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，米奇·麦康奈尔绝不可能对总统一直在说的话感到高兴。

sentences.en: But how he chooses to deal with that, I think, is an open question, and it will be determined by what the president does in the coming weeks
sentences.zh: 但他选择如何应对，我认为这是一个开放的问题，这将由总统在未来几周内的所作所为来决定，

sentences.en: and when this election is called and exactly how it's called.
sentences.zh: 以及这场选举何时被宣布结果以及具体如何被宣布。

sentences.en: — But the biggest question for me, honestly, in terms of systems is conservative media.
sentences.zh: ——但老实说，就系统而言，对我来说最大的问题是保守派媒体。

sentences.en: — Because conservative media has been so incredibly important to the president's rise in the first place as a candidate.
sentences.zh: ——因为保守派媒体对于总统最初作为候选人的崛起实在是太重要了。

sentences.en: — And so if they turn on him—
sentences.zh: ——所以如果他们背叛了他——

sentences.en: — If they turn on him, then it will be, I think, a lot harder for him to get oxygen
sentences.zh: ——如果他们背叛了他，那么我认为，他要想获得舆论氧气

sentences.en: and to sustain whatever it is he's trying to do to keep the election going, if he is at that point.
sentences.zh: 并维持他为了让选举继续下去而正在做的任何事情，就会困难得多，如果他到时候还在坚持的话。

sentences.en: — Without those three, without all of those three, there's really no path.
sentences.zh: ——如果没有这三者，没有这三者全部的支持，那就真的行不通了。

sentences.en: — You know, regardless of whether the systems support the president in this strategy or tell him it's time to stop it,
sentences.zh: ——你知道的，无论这些系统是否在这一策略上支持总统，还是告诉他是时候停止了，

sentences.en: and I guess regardless of exactly how the president proceeds over the next few weeks, if he ends up losing,
sentences.zh: 而且我猜无论总统在接下来的几周里究竟如何行事，如果他最终落败的话，

sentences.en: I wonder what you think this message from him is going to mean for the 69 million people who voted for him
sentences.zh: 我想知道你认为他发出的这一信息对于那6900万投票支持他的人来说意味着什么。

sentences.en: as they think about the 73 million fellow Americans, their neighbors and their co-workers, who voted for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 当他们想到那7300万投给乔·拜登的美国同胞、他们的邻居和同事时。

sentences.en: I mean, what is this going to do to half the country?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这对半个国家会产生什么影响？

sentences.en: — Part of why the U.S.
sentences.zh: ——部分原因在于美国

sentences.en: system works historically is faith in it and belief that it is ultimately one of integrity and one to be believed in.
sentences.zh: 体制在历史上之所以能运作，是因为人们对它抱有信心，相信它归根结底是正直的，是值得信赖的。

sentences.en: And if you have literally half or slightly less than half the country
sentences.zh: 如果你发现字面上半数或略少于半数的国民

sentences.en: potentially questioning that, it's very hard to go back.
sentences.zh: 潜在地对此产生质疑，那就很难回头了。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: ——没错。

sentences.en: We've already seen trust in our media undermined.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到人们对媒体的信任被侵蚀。

sentences.en: We've already seen trust in our government undermined.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到人们对政府的信任被侵蚀。

sentences.en: But it feels like what we haven't seen faith undermined in, where it still exists, was in our election system.
sentences.zh: 但感觉上，在我们尚未失去信心的地方，也就是它依然存在的地方，就是我们的选举制度。

sentences.en: — That's right.
sentences.zh: ——正是如此。

sentences.en: So in 2000, Michael, a lot of people had their faith in the election system shaken because the presidential election was contested.
sentences.zh: 所以在2000年，迈克尔，许多人对选举制度的信心动摇了，因为总统大选存在争议。

sentences.en: — But in that contest, you had two nominees, Al Gore and George W.
sentences.zh: ——但在那场争议中，你有两位候选人，阿尔·戈尔和乔治·W.

sentences.en: Bush, who were committed to the sanctity and integrity of how people viewed this process.
sentences.zh: 布什，他们致力于维护人们看待这一过程的神圣性和正直性。

sentences.en: And they were committed to moving forward peacefully.
sentences.zh: 并且他们致力于和平地推进。

sentences.en: That is not what Donald Trump is committed to.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普可不是这么想的。

sentences.en: He has made that very clear with everything he has done this week.
sentences.zh: 他通过本周所做的一切把这一点表露得非常清楚。

sentences.en: And he and his family members are openly pressuring other Republicans to join him in that call.
sentences.zh: 他和他的家人正公开施压其他共和党人加入他的呼吁。

sentences.en: — Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: ——嗯哼。

sentences.en: — This is a potentially dangerous escalation.
sentences.zh: ——这是一个潜在的危险升级。

sentences.en: — Well, this is one of those interviews where it doesn't quite feel like thank you is the right word, but I appreciate your time, Maggie.
sentences.zh: ——好吧，这是一场让人觉得说“谢谢”不太对劲的采访，但我很感激你能抽出时间，玛吉。

sentences.en: — Michael, thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: ——迈克尔，谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: — As of early Friday morning, Joe Biden was 17 electoral college votes shy of reaching the 270 needed to win, while President Trump needed 56 electoral college votes.
sentences.zh: ——截至周五清晨，乔·拜登距离赢得大选所需的270张选举人票还差17张，而特朗普总统则需要56张选举人票。

sentences.en: As counting continued in several battleground states,
sentences.zh: 随着几个摇摆州的计票工作持续进行，

sentences.en: Biden appeared to be on the cusp of taking the lead in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 拜登似乎即将在宾夕法尼亚州取得领先。

sentences.en: If that were to happen and Biden were to win the state, he would surpass 270 and win the presidency.
sentences.zh: 如果果真如此且拜登赢得该州，他将突破270票并赢得总统大选。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In a series of closely-watched referendums in California, voters there rejected affirmative action, an expansion of rent control, and a law that gives greater labor protections
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州的一系列备受瞩目的公投中，当地选民否决了平权法案、租金管制的扩大，以及一项旨在为

sentences.en: to ride-sharing and delivery drivers.
sentences.zh: 网约车和外卖司机提供更多劳工保护的法律。

sentences.en: The outcomes were a stinging setback for liberals in the country's largest state and a reliable bastion of progressive reform.
sentences.zh: 这些结果对这个美国最大且作为进步改革可靠堡垒的州的自由派来说，是一个沉重的挫折。

sentences.en: In the most prominent referendum,
sentences.zh: 在最受瞩目的公投中，

sentences.en: California voters allowed companies like Uber, Lyft, and DoorDash to avoid having to employ drivers and pay for benefits like health care and unemployment insurance,
sentences.zh: 加州选民允许优步、来福车和DoorDash等公司免于将司机雇为员工并支付医疗保险和失业保险等福利，

sentences.en: a measure that was heavily supported by labor unions.
sentences.zh: 这是一项受到工会强烈支持的法案。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，将讲述那些试图维持自身影响力却在过程中失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.zh: 《都市》。
